scouting.policy: Sourced observations for review. No automatic opinion-based point adjustment.

claims.observation: Tavernier scored a close-range goal in the ninth minute after beating Hornicek to a loose ball following Alex Scott's deflected shot.
Tavernier had another big chance after being picked out by Truffert, but shot straight at Hornicek.
Barnes scored a bending finish past Petrovic from near the left corner of the area late in the first half.
Kluivert's speculative effort hit the post, then Hornicek's back, before rolling wide; it did not produce a goal.

Ballard lashed a loose ball beyond Kelleher after Collins failed to clear Xhaka's lofted free-kick, but the goal was disallowed after a lengthy VAR review because Danso interfered from an offside position.
claims.quote: the goal was disallowed after a lengthy VAR review

claims.observation: Sadiki got a poked effort from inside the six-yard box, but Kelleher was equal to it.
Schade's long throw earned Brentford a corner in the 90th minute.
claims.quote: long throw earned Brentford a corner

claims.observation: Thiago met Lewis-Potter's cross with a downward header that bounced awkwardly in front of Roefs and was pushed away.
Played on the left, often providing an overlap threat in the first half and defending intelligently as City's backs were against the wall in the second.
Deployed in the No.10 role, wasn't as inventive as Cherki there but was sensible in possession to help protect the lead.
Highly creative showing; carved out chances, particularly for Haaland, and ought to have had at least one assist.
Made threatening moves in behind, some picked out and some not; couldn't take some chances but was clinical for the winner.
Came into the starting side after O'Reilly's warm-up injury; played a key role in the first goal, was denied a first assist by a tight offside, and influence waned before his second-half withdrawal.
Haaland has scored eight goals in seven Premier League appearances against Manchester United, though just two of those have come at Old Trafford.
claims.quote: scored eight goals in seven Premier League appearances against Manchester United

transfer_review.method: Best affordable single replacement per holding; fixed hold, optimal legal XI/captain and auto-sub cover, net of hits.
transfer_review.caveat: Scenarios are hypotheses, not measured decline. They hold the incoming player unchanged and do not value future information. The multi-week planner compares acting now with waiting.
transfer_review.threshold_status: The legacy 2-point-per-move threshold is a heuristic, not a validated edge.

case_studies.note: Completed fixtures only. Samples and opponents differ; total xG includes penalties. These are observations, not a fitted decline or a promise of future returns.
